title: Nana
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Two 20-year-old women both named Nana meet on a train to Tokyo and become roommates: punk singer Nana Osaki chasing a music career and romantic Nana 'Hachi' Komatsu. Their friendship is tested by love affairs, a pregnancy and marriage, fame, addiction and loss.
life_message: A good life means loyal friendship and the courage to pursue your own path, though love and ambition carry real costs.

winners_losers: The friendship between the two Nanas holds the story's sympathy; ambition, addiction and possessive love take a heavy toll, and no one simply wins. The series is unfinished.
